record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The five units in appliesTo declare BITE in this production reference (all with passive NONE in the catalog). The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats.
record.summary: Single-target special damage (40/80/120 raw by stars); the caster then heals for 30% (rounded up) of the damage the target actually took, and the target is flinched for 5000 ms if it took more than 0 damage.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: then the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later untraced modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (takenDamage 0, so no heal and no flinch)

effects.scaling: ceil(0.3 x takenDamage) where takenDamage is the value returned by handleSpecialDamage; apBoost 0 and crit false are passed, so neither AP nor crit scales it
effects.resolution: handleHeal then applies: nothing if the caster is wounded (status.wound) or at 0 hp or protected; x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather; rounded and capped at missing HP

statusEffects.applicationOrder: after damage and heal; only if takenDamage > 0
statusEffects.guards: not applied if runeProtect; duration passes through applyStatusDurationReductions; a new flinch replaces the remaining time only if longer
statusEffects.combatEffect: while flinched, damage that would hit a shield is split: half is dealt to the shield and half is residual damage to HP. This is the only use of status.flinch found in app/core and app/models outside status.ts; other directories were not searched.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (200, also the fallback) is not reachable by the five units' bare star counts (1, 2, 3). maxPP is 80 for Carvanha/Sharpedo and 90 for Larvitar/Pupitar/Tyranitar; range 1 for all.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (the unit must be in range of it to cast, since requiresTarget is true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast repeats damage, heal and flinch; a second flinch only extends the timer if longer.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 40/80/120 (1/2/3 stars). Damage dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced modifiers; the heal is ceil(30% x that dealt amount) before the handleHeal modifiers; flinch is 5000 ms before status duration reductions.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read; takenDamage may therefore differ from the damage after SPE_DEF if shields absorb it (what takenDamage counts was not traced)
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
unresolved: What 'takenDamage' returned by handleSpecialDamage counts when the target has a shield (the heal and flinch depend on it); the relevant tail of handleDamage was not fully read
Whether the flinch has other combat effects in files outside app/core and app/models that were searched
Whether any item or synergy effect changes BITE beyond what is listed
Tyranitar / Pupitar / Larvitar and Carvanha / Sharpedo have no passive in the catalog; no other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue
